definitions.gloss: to be all present, to be complete, to all come together
definitions.explanation: For all expected members, items, or elements to have arrived or appeared. Implies that the full set is now assembled.

examples.japanese: ⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出揃|でそろ}った。
⟦{各社|かくしゃ}→各社：11057_kakusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新製品|しんせいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出揃|でそろ}った。
examples.english: New products from all the companies have come out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出揃|でそろ}った⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{選挙戦|せんきょせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{本格的|ほんかくてき}→本格的：05681_honkakuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Once all the candidates had come forward, the election campaign began in earnest.

notes:
{出揃|でそろ}う is a compound verb from ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to come out) + ⟦{揃|そろ}う→揃う：01953_sorou⟧ (to be complete/aligned). It means all expected members or items have appeared or been gathered.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- Pattern: 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出揃|でそろ}う

ASPECT (ている):
{出揃|でそろ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates the resulting state — everything is now assembled.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出揃|でそろ}う: all members are present
- ⟦{顔|かお}ぶれ→顔ぶれ：14671_kaobure⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出揃|でそろ}う: the full lineup is assembled
- ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出揃|でそろ}う: all results are in
- ⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出揃|でそろ}う: all candidates have come forward
- ⟦{役者|やくしゃ}→役者：05113_yakusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出揃|でそろ}う: all actors are assembled (also figurative: "the stage is set")

REGISTER:
Common in news reporting and business contexts. Often used when the last piece completes a set.
